name: AIStatusPill
description: Tone-driven pill with a leading icon (check for success, alert triangle for warning / critical, dot for neutral / info) and a label. Five tones map to the metric-card accent system so the pill, the card dot, and the bottom rail share one color story.
intent: Tone-aware status pill for any card or row that needs a quick "is this OK?" read.
